messages:
OpsBot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-4521 — model node crash loop affecting model-service-us-east-1. Auto-detected by heartbeat monitor.

Jae (eng-oncall): I'm on it. seeing repeated container restarts on node gpu-13, all for model v2.3. Root cause unclear yet.

Priya (infra): thanks. node shows kernel messages about GPU driver fault (NVIDIA) and then oom_kill for process 'model-loader'. attaching dmesg snippet below.
```
NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x30:0x44:843)
Out of memory: Killed process 18234 (model-loader) total-vm:16384256kB, anon-rss:14336000kB
```

Lena (sre): customer reports 5xx from hosted API routes hitting that model, ~18% error increase over last 7m. Carmen, can you confirm customer impact scope?

Carmen (support): Customer A - svc-team reports latency spikes and generation errors since ~09:12 UTC. They have a canary pointing to model v2.3; fallback to v2.1 works. They're asking for ETA.

Sam (runtime): logs from model-loader show deserialization failures before oom: "artifact CRC mismatch" followed by aggressive memory growth during tensor deserialization. Also seeing compile-timeouts in our JIT step: "kernel compile exceeded 120s, aborting".

Jae (eng-oncall): interesting — compile timeout then OOM. Could be corrupted artifact causing fallback to expensive CPU path and memory blow-up. Priya, can we isolate node and prevent new loads?

Priya (infra): cordoning node gpu-13 and draining new pods now. scaling down replica set for model v2.3 to 0 in that AZ to stop stampede. command: `kubectl scale deploy model-v2-3 --replicas=0 -n model-prod-us-east`

OpsBot: Handoff note — Jae -> Priya for infrastructure isolation at 09:20 UTC.

Lena (sre): mitigation plan suggestion: 1) stop new v2.3 loads (done), 2) deploy temporary routing rule to send traffic to v2.1 or cpu-fallback pool, 3) collect a failing artifact and run local deserialization debug.

Sam (runtime): I grabbed the artifact from s3 and did a local load: deserializer error stack: "unexpected EOF while parsing tensor metadata". When forced to retry, the loader attempted an unsafe mmap path and memory climbed ~14GB then crashed. Repro steps and hash: s3://artifacts/models/v2.3/sha256:ab12...cd.

Jae (eng-oncall): good repro. For immediate customer relief we should route Customer A's traffic to v2.1 and issue a controlled rollback of v2.3 for all tenants using that model until artifact verification fixed. Carmen please notify Customer A that we are failing over them to v2.1 and investigating artifact integrity; give them a 30m ETA.

Carmen (support): notified. Customer A acknowledged and switched their canary to v2.1. They want a postmortem and whether data was touched.

Priya (infra): root cause hypothesis: partial artifact upload produced corrupted layers; when the runtime attempted an optimized GPU deserialization + JIT compile, it hit a pathological code path causing compile timeouts and then large in-memory buffering -> kernel OOM -> container crash loop.

Sam (runtime): temporary mitigation we can do quickly: 1) force model server to verify artifact checksum before enabling fast-path deserialization, 2) add a retry that falls back earlier to a memory-safe path, 3) extend compile timeout back to 300s as a short-term guard (gives more time but not ideal). I'll push a hotfix branch now.

Lena (sre): please also open a ticket to scan recent artifact uploads for CRC mismatch and quarantine any that fail. Add an alert to catch "deserializer EOF" errors at higher severity.

Jae (eng-oncall): agreed. I'll create INC-4521-1 task list and own follow-ups. Priorities: customer comms, artifact quarantine, hotfix rollout, and post-incident review.

OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Action items created: INC-4521-CHK (artifact scan), INC-4521-HF (runtime hotfix), INC-4521-COMM (customer comms).

Sam (runtime): hotfix deployed to canary: added pre-load checksum verification and an immediate fallback to CPU-safe deserializer on failure. Observing no new crash loops on test nodes after patch.

Priya (infra): uncordoning node gpu-13 after we patched and restarted drivers; keeping it under watch.

Carmen (support): Customer A confirmed errors dropped to baseline and are happy with temporary mitigation. They asked for ETA on full rollback or re-release; we told them 24-48h after artifact validation.

Lena (sre): leaving this thread for the postmortem; handoff to oncall tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. Jae — assign followups for long-term fix (artifact pipeline integrity, deserializer hardening, compile-time telemetry).

Jae (eng-oncall): will do. Closing live mitigation loop. :thumbsup:
